semantics.REGISTER: Verify native observer and classification consistency, then atomically insert one jobs/detail pair or return same-owner/classification snapshot unchanged. CREATED only for new row.
semantics.CLAIM: Only matching owner with verified live identity and REGISTERED/no prior claim may atomically commit LAUNCHING. Identical already-claimed retry returns current matching snapshot UNCHANGED; it is never a new launch permission.
semantics.ATTACH: Matching owner binds one original child tuple after a launch claim. Exact repeat unchanged even after completion; different tuple conflicts. A first attach after terminal completion is invalid. Native probe evidence, not the assertion alone, determines verification. Missing/indeterminate attachment is retained unverified in OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; a later matching probe can verify it.

job.complete.semantics: Accept actual same-owner observation only after launch claim. Bind immutable tagged outcome atomically; exact repeat UNCHANGED without timestamp/revision rewrite; conflicting owner/outcome JOB_CONFLICT. Unknown can refine to observed outcome. No reaping/launch by daemon. Owner equality uses stored tuple; an ended original observer does not invalidate previously committed same-value completion.

job.status.semantics: BY_ID returns NOT_FOUND or one reconciled snapshot through the bounded worker. RECENT reads 51 summaries using an index ordered by created_at DESC,id DESC, returns first 50 and truncated; no cursor/unbounded scan and no per-row native probes. Summaries are explicitly last-known state, liveness_fresh=false; select an ID for current reconciliation. Status never claims, launches or reserves work.

retry_policy.details: Adopt the bounded policy documented by task-1 and implemented in exec/transport.rs: at most three identical metadata exchanges under one monotonic 2000 ms deadline, each capped at 600 ms and remaining time; no sleeps or automatic interleaved status requests. Retry ambiguous transport loss/DB_BUSY with the same key, payload and request correlation; validate acknowledgements. Identical mutation replies can resolve possible commits without an intervening status. Definitive protocol/conflict/transition failures stop the action. Optional BY_ID status uses the same bound but never authorizes launch. Unconfirmed REGISTER/CLAIM means this invocation never reaches its sole spawn site. After spawn, tracking/completion failures never kill, relaunch or replace the observed child outcome. Native wait has no runtime timeout.
retry_policy.decision: The earlier 12000 ms/backoff/interleaved-status policy was a task-4 design detail, not an immutable mission gate. Prefer the existing smaller bounded implementation; retain durable confirmation, no replay and all deterministic loss/timeout tests. No saved assignment or verification command changes.

reconciliation.strategy: Lazy BY_ID reconciliation through finite existing worker; no unbounded startup history sweep or task-per-row. Restart reads durable rows as needed, never replays work.
reconciliation.procedure: Read snapshot/revision under the existing bounded worker, release ticket; probe native metadata; submit conditional update matching revision+child tuple+nonterminal state through the same queue. At most three read/probe/update attempts total within the unchanged request deadline (initial plus at most two stale-revision retries). Observed terminal snapshot wins immediately; after exhaustion return static DB_BUSY, never stale verification as current. No probe overwrites terminal outcome.

cli.terminal: Follow operator note 2026-11-08T15:24:49.402Z. With a controlling terminal, retain the caller job process group, including background jobs: no process_group(0), setpgid or tcsetpgrp; no terminal INT/QUIT group or PID forwarding. OS job control delivers terminal INT/QUIT/TSTP to eligible peers. Forward received TERM/HUP/USR1/USR2 only to the owned child PID. Wait with WUNTRACED|WCONTINUED, mirror a still-outstanding child stop via wrapper SIGSTOP and resume on SIGCONT without taking foreground. Use private child group only without a controlling terminal or in detached/managed execution without caller peers. Retain inherited dispositions/masks, preattach protection, stop/continue ordering, terminal modes, closed descriptors and native parent-visible signaled status (shell convention 128+signal). Never infer PID-versus-group provenance from sender metadata or broadcast wrapper-only signals to peers. Deterministic direct/wrapped native PTY/pipeline checks remain required.
